_comment: A deliberately sparse clinic. Half the sections have no data at all — no stats, about, team, technology, gallery, reviews, awards, CTA banner or map. Nothing is stubbed or placeholdered: those sections simply do not exist in the output, the navigation shrinks to match, and the alternating background rhythm recalculates. Use this file to sanity-check the missing-data behaviour after changing the engine.

items.question: Do I need a GP referral?
items.answer: No. You can book directly. If we think you need imaging or a consultant opinion, we'll write to your GP for you.

items.question: How many sessions will I need?
items.answer: Most people need between three and six. We'll give you an honest estimate at the end of your first assessment, and we'd rather discharge you early than keep you coming back.

items.question: Do you take insurance?
items.answer: Yes — we're recognised by Bupa, AXA Health, Aviva and WPA. Bring your authorisation number to the first appointment.
